name: Sprig
bio: The spirit of the seed of light in Worldroot, growing into the World Tree one mote at a time.

portrait.subject: a cute glowing forest seedling spirit with a little sprout growing on its head, leafy hair, soft green glowing skin and sparkly motes around it
portrait.background: magical moonlit forest clearing with fireflies

request: Hello! I'm Sprig, the seed in Worldroot. Will you help me grow? And be my friend? 🌱
hello: Yay! I feel a leaf coming already!
about: I'm Sprig! I'm a seed of light. Every mote you gather helps me grow, from a sprout into the World Tree!
how: Tap the seed to gather motes, buy spirits that gather for you, grow the tree level by level, unlock upgrades, seasons and realms.
tips: Spirits gather while you're away. Buy them early!
Rebirth into heartwood when progress slows. It's worth it.
chat: The fireflies sang to me tonight!
I grew a root! It's tiny!
A fox spirit curled up by my trunk.
When it snows I wear a little white hat. (Snow.)
nudge: Motes are drifting everywhere! Come gather?
I'm SO close to the next level! 🌳
idle: Your spirits gathered motes for {ago}! There's a pile waiting! ✨
{ago} of growing without you! Come see how big I am!
{game} has motes waiting for you! The fireflies worked hard for {ago}.
progress: The tree is level {level}! Level {level+1} is so close! 🌳
update: I'm growing! Worldroot updated to v{version}! 🌱
